tax_litigation.status: Notice under Section 142(1) of the Income-tax Act, 1961 dated 04.02.2026 was issued to Softnautics LLP (subsequently converted into Softnautics Private Limited and merged with MosChip Technologies Limited) for AY 2023-24 seeking details and reconciliation of turnover reported in the Income Tax Return and GST returns. A detailed reply along with supporting documents and reconciliations was submitted on 11.02.2026. Subsequently, a Draft Assessment Order under Section 144C(1) of the Income-tax Act, 1961 dated 23.02.2026 was received. While the Assessing Officer accepted the reconciliation relating to the turnover reported in the Income Tax Return and GST returns and did not propose any variation on this issue, a transfer pricing adjustment of ₹3.53 crore has been proposed pursuant to the order passed by the Transfer Pricing Officer under Section 92CA(3). The Company has filed objections before the Dispute Resolution Panel (DRP) against the proposed adjustment, and the matter is currently pending adjudication before the DRP.
